name: Night City
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. It's color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional advantages.
interestingFacts: Night City was part of a special Shop bundle available for 59.90 USD during the 2019 Tanker's Day celebrations. The bundle also contained 25 000 crystals and 15 containers.
This paint was added into the game on 5th September 2019 as part of the 2019 Tanker's Day celebrations. Simultaneously it was added to Containers permanently.
Hot pink lights on a cold city night? You'll be the life of the party wearing this paint.
